_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Woyɛ Player {player_id} wɔ {num_players}-player Liar's Dice agorɔ mu.
Mmara:
- Wɔ wo turn, wobɛtumi:
  1) Yɛ bid foforɔ a ɛwɔ quantity kɛseɛ anaa face kɛseɛ (anaa ne nyinaa) sen sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ; i.e. '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Frɛ last bid no denam '[Call]'.

Sɛ wofrɛ a:
  - Sɛ actual count no yɛ face value no mu wɔ dice nyinaa mu no yɛ kɔm deɛ bid no, last bidder no hwɛ die baako.
  - Sɛ ɛnteɛ a, caller no hwɛ die baako.
Akyerɛwfoɔ a ɔhwɛ dice 0 no pɛ agorɔ no. Akyerɛwfoɔ a ɔsɛe no di nkunim.

board.new_round:
Round foforɔ - Remaining dice: {dice_summary}
Wo Dice a wɔde di agorɔ no ne: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Player {current_player_id} frɛe! Actual count no yɛ face {face_value} no mu yɛ {count}, a ɛyɛ kɔm deɛ {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (last bidder) hwɛ die baako.
call.caller_loses:
Player {current_player_id} frɛe! Actual count no yɛ face {face_value} no mu yɛ {count}, a ɛyɛ kɛseɛ deɛ {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (caller) hwɛ die baako.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Wɔfrɛɛ no bere a na wɔnkaa ho asɛm.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Action yɛn hu sɛ ɛyɛ '[Bid: X, Y]' anaa '[Call]' valid. Action a ɛsɛe: {action}

bid_reason.face_lower: Face value foforɔ {new_face_value} no yɛ kɔm deɛ sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ {current_face_value}.
